query: Evaluating a 79‑year‑old man with hemorrhagic stroke. Among male ICU patients 74–84, what is the 90th‑percentile first‑48‑h instability (hours with fever>38.5°C, SpO2<90% or RR>20), and for the top decile report n, mean ICU LOS, mortality%, and mean hours fever, hypoxemia, tachypnea?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.instability_hours) AS ninety_percentile, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.los AS avg_los, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.dod AS avg_mortality_rate, AVG(male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.instability_hours) AS avg_hours_with_instability FROM male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted GROUP BY male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.subject_id, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.hadm_id, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.los, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.dod ORDER BY male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.subject_id, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.hadm_id, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.los, male_icu_patients_with_instability_sorted.dod NULLS LAST;
